instruction.name: str.d
instruction.description: store right part of a value to an unaligned 64-bit address

notes: LBT MIPS-style unaligned store, measured with a 64-byte-aligned stack buffer on LA464. No latency is recorded because a store has no register result.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 50 --unroll2 200 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22' --asm 'str.d $r4, $r20, 4; str.d $r5, $r20, 0; str.d $r6, $r20, 4; str.d $r7, $r20, 0; str.d $r8, $r20, 4; str.d $r9, $r20, 0; str.d $r10, $r20, 4; str.d $r11, $r20, 0'
throughput.notes: Eight independent stores to the same aligned base. A store has no register result, so only the throughput is recorded.
